text:
leo-sales: Heads-up — Meridian asks for an accelerated joint proof-of-concept. They want Dedicated capacity + VPC peering and SSO. Potentially sensitive customer records (may be PHI). Need scope, security checklist, and two commercial options (reserved vs pay-as-you-go). Can we triage?

maria-partner: Looping Meridian PM (cc). They shared a short questionnaire and SAML metadata link. Their preference: Dedicated for predictability, but open to Private if compliance demands it.

sam-solutions: Quick clarifying Qs: what qps and avg prompt length? retention for audit logs? Are they expecting telemetry exports?

leo-sales: Meridian estimates ~150 qps sustained, spikes to 400 qps, avg request ~800 tokens, audit logs 12 months, may want Postgres export of telemetry for compliance. Contact: alice.m@meridian.com

anya-arch: From infra side two options: 1) dedicated shared tenant with strict network isolation + IP-based egress allowlist; 2) fully isolated tenant per customer. For any PHI we should recommend isolated tenant in Private mode. Ballpark infra: for 150 sustained / 400 peak with <200ms p99 on small model -> 3x A100 equiv (depending on model/quantization). I'll draft provisioning commands.

sophie-sec: Security asks: SOC2 docs, dataflow diagram, encryption proof (at rest + in transit), KMS/BYOK options, SAML SP metadata, IP egress list, and team contacts for incident response. I can start filling their questionnaire. Who at Meridian owns security?

maria-partner: Alice (alice.m@meridian.com) is the security lead. She sent the SAML XML.

raj-pricing: I'll assemble two SKUs: (A) 90-day Dedicated commit w/ support & telemetry export; (B) Hosted fallback + usage billing. Need token/month estimate — leo said 150 qps sustained -> rough tokens = 150 qps * 3600s * 30d * avg 800 tokens ~ 1.296B tokens/month (this seems high). Leo can you confirm whether 150 qps is per-tenant concurrent requests or total across flows?

leo-sales: Good point, that was peak-concurrent ops. They clarified: 150 concurrent users rather than constant qps; expected monthly tokens ~120M. Sorry for confusion.

sam-solutions: For test plan we should include a lightweight eval harness: 50 synthetic prompts, latency + output-quality smoke tests, and a regression check pre/post deploy. I'll create a repo skeleton.

anya-arch: Runbook draft (commands):
```bash
# meridian poc runbook - initial
# 1) Provision dedicated pool
redwood provision dedicated --region us-west-2 --gpus 4 --tenant meridian-poc --name "meridian-poc-1"

# 2) VPC peering and route table
aws ec2 create-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-id vpc-redwood --peer-vpc-id vpc-meridian
aws ec2 accept-vpc-peering-connection --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-XXXXX

# 3) Import SAML metadata
redwood saml import --tenant meridian-poc --file meridian_saml.xml

# 4) Enable audit logs -> S3 + telemetry export to syslog / Postgres
redwood audit set --tenant meridian-poc --retention 365d --export s3://meridian-logs

# 5) Enable BYOK (if Private requested)
redwood kms bind --tenant meridian-poc --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/XXX
```

sophie-sec: I'll prepare a redacted dataflow diagram and attach SOC2 summary. Also flagging that if PHI is confirmed we need a DPA update and encryption attestation.

raj-pricing: Updated estimate: two options using 120M tokens/month: Dedicated 3mo commit -> ~$18k/mo + telemetry export fees. Hosted fallback per-token tiers added as opt-in. I'll post formal quote by Fri EOD.

maria-partner: Meridian asks for a short dated runbook and a minimal test plan before the prewire call. Can we have those by Tue?

leo-sales: I can confirm Meridian's decision-maker for commits (Head of Engineering) will attend Tue call. Calendar invite incoming.

asana-bot: Task created: "Meridian POC runbook + quote" assigned to anya-arch, sam-solutions, raj-pricing due Tue 09:00 PT.

sam-solutions: I'll sketch the eval harness and push a PR to internal/repo/pocs/meridian-test.

anya-arch: I'll finish the full runbook and network diagrams, will link them in this thread when ready.

sophie-sec: I'll DM Alice to get missing questionnaire fields and confirm whether data is PHI. Also will attach SOC2 and redacted diag.

leo-sales: Thanks team — please thumbs up in thread when your tasks are set. We'll use this channel for prewire notes only.

maria-partner: :thumbsup:

leo-sales: :white_check_mark:
